measures.title: The Cook County Millionaire Amendment for Property Tax Relief and Education
measures.question: Shall Illinois adopt the Millionaire Amendment for Property Tax Relief and Education, which would enact a 3% income tax surcharge only on millionaires and use 50% of this new revenue to provide property tax relief for residential and commercial taxpayers and 50% to improve state funding for public education?

measures.title: Restart Chicago Gunshot Detection
measures.question: Should the City of Chicago restart the use of gunshot detection technology that informs first responders when gunshots are detected?

measures.title: Permanent Chicago Festival Space
measures.question: Should Chicago develop a permanent festival and outdoor event space for large-scale events?

measures.title: Chicago Cost Recovery from Midway Blitz
measures.question: Shall the City of Chicago pursue all lawful means to recover financial compensation from the federal government for the costs and economic harm caused by the Donald Trump administration's violent, militarized ICE operations, including the Midway Blitz operation led by Greg Bovino, to recover lost tax revenue, public safety response costs, and services provided to residents and families affected by those operations?

measures.title: ADVISORY QUESTION REGARDING MILLIONAIRES SURCHARGE
measures.question: Shall Illinois use revenue from a surcharge on millionaires to increase funding to public schools?

measures.title: ADVISORY QUESTION REGARDING CHICAGO LAND OWNERS
measures.question: Should the City of Chicago require owners of long-term vacant or undeveloped commercial or investment properties to pay an additional annual charge that would support Chicago Public Schools?

measures.title: Mid-Northside Expanded Mental Health Services
measures.question: Shall there be established, to serve the territory commonly described on this ballot or notice of this question, a Mid- Northside Expanded Mental Health Services Program, to provide direct free mental health services for any resident of the territory who needs assistance in overcoming or coping with mental or emotional disorders, where such program will be funded through an increase of not more than .025% of the equalized assessed valuation of all properties within the boundaries of the territory?

scope.name: Mid-Northside Expanded Mental Health Services Program Area

measures.title: 2027 Property Tax Extension - Mid-Northside Expanded Mental Health Services
measures.question: Under the Property Tax Extension Limitation Law, may an aggregate extension not to exceed $1,300,000 be made for the Mid-Northside Expanded Mental Health Services Program for the 2027 levy year?

scope.name: Mid-Northside Expanded Mental Health Services Program Area

measures.title: Far Southwest Side Expanded Mental Health Services
measures.question: Shall there be established, to serve the territory commonly described on this ballot or notice of this question, an Far Southwest Side Expanded Mental Health Services Program, to provide direct free mental health services for any resident of the territory who needs assistance in overcoming or coping with mental or emotional disorders, where such program will be funded through an increase of not more than .025% of the equalized assessed valuation of all properties within the boundaries of the territory?

scope.name: Far Southwest Side Expanded Mental Health Services Program Area

measures.title: 2027 Property Tax Extension - Far Southwest Side Expanded Mental Health Services
measures.question: Under the Property Tax Extension Limitation Law, may an aggregate extension not to exceed $900,000 be made for the Far Southwest Side Expanded Mental Health Services Program for the 2027 levy year?

scope.name: Far Southwest Side Expanded Mental Health Services Program Area

measures.title: Jesse Jackson Monument Statue
measures.question: through referendum that to become a city ordinance supported by the city do hereby petition that the question, should at least a life-size statue of the likeness of Jesse Lewis Jackson Sr. sitting on a monument to be placed in the median at approximately 4946 South Drexel, Chicago Illinois be a public policy to place on the ballot and submitted to the voters of the fourth (4th) ward for their approval or disapproval by referendum at the General Election to be held on November 3rd 2026. This initiative is to become realized by November 2027. This proposal should give homage to a great American Patriot and a token symbol of America's appreciation.

measures.title: Shared Housing Limits in 26th Ward
measures.question: Shall new shared housing units be limited in the 26th Ward to help address Chicago’s severe rental housing shortage?

measures.title: Chicago Lakefront National Park
measures.question: Shall the City of Chicago support the nomination of a Chicago Lakefront National Park, consisting of all of Chicago's park and public lands adjacent to Lake Michigan including their harbors, lagoons, and inlets?
